redistribution: user_must_obtain_source; this repo does not vendor the full matrix

raw_sources.name: cells.csv
raw_sources.note: GEO file names/URLs were not locked in this revision. Place author cell/sample/drug/dose/time/vehicle annotations here.

raw_sources.name: counts.csv
raw_sources.note: Author primary processing counts (cells x genes). Do not substitute an HVG-scaled third-party h5ad.

notes: fetch-data reports files the user must obtain; it does not guess wget URLs.
prepare-data reads author-format cells.csv + counts.csv|counts.h5ad and writes prepared/sciplex3/v1.
A third-party processed h5ad is not labeled raw counts unless matrix_kind and layer are declared.
Input is an explicit data directory; /data/ppnm is never implied.
